# Replayed intl402 checks that fail by design: <file or file#index> <reason>. The suite only ships Latin digits.
NumberFormat/prototype/format/numbering-systems.js Only the Latin numbering system is supported; every other system falls back to latn.
Intl/supportedValuesOf/numberingSystems-accepted-by-NumberFormat.js supportedValuesOf('numberingSystem') lists the systems of the data set; this implementation carries latn only.
Intl/supportedValuesOf/numberingSystems-accepted-by-RelativeTimeFormat.js Same as above for RelativeTimeFormat.
NumberFormat/prototype/resolvedOptions/resolved-numbering-system-unicode-extensions-and-options.js Expects non-Latin numbering systems (arab) to resolve; only latn is supported.
RelativeTimeFormat/prototype/resolvedOptions/resolved-numbering-system-unicode-extensions-and-options.js Same as above for RelativeTimeFormat.
NumberFormat/constructor-roundingIncrement-invalid.js#3 A fractional roundingIncrement (5000.1) is rejected by GetNumberOption in the option-reading layer, which converts to an integer before the service sees it.
# Date-time and duration formatting: only the Gregorian calendar and Latin digits are carried.
Intl/supportedValuesOf/numberingSystems-accepted-by-DateTimeFormat.js Every numbering system listed by supportedValuesOf must be accepted by DateTimeFormat; only latn is carried.
DurationFormat/constructor-options-numberingSystem-valid.js Expects every numbering system supportedValuesOf lists to resolve; only latn is carried.
Intl/supportedValuesOf/calendars-accepted-by-DateTimeFormat.js Expects every calendar supportedValuesOf lists to resolve; only gregory is carried.
DurationFormat/prototype/resolvedOptions/resolved-numbering-system-unicode-extensions-and-options.js Expects non-Latin numbering systems (arab) and the -u-nu extension to resolve.
DateTimeFormat/prototype/resolvedOptions/resolved-numbering-system-unicode-extensions-and-options.js Expects non-Latin numbering systems (arab) and the -u-nu extension to resolve.
DateTimeFormat/prototype/resolvedOptions/resolved-calendar-unicode-extensions-and-options.js Expects non-Gregorian calendars (iso8601) and the -u-ca extension to resolve.
DateTimeFormat/canonicalize-calendar.js Expects calendar aliases (islamic-civil, ...) to resolve to their calendar; only gregory is carried.
